timeline.title: Software Engineer
timeline.description: Built a scalable climate intelligence platform for DSSAT workflows by processing multi-terabyte geospatial data on S3, automating fault-tolerant ingestion with Docker and ECS/Fargate, and delivering high-throughput async services with Zarr, Redis, Qdrant, and PostgreSQL.
achievements: Architected a scalable climate-data platform on Amazon S3 for ingesting and processing multi-terabyte CHIRPS raster datasets into optimized Zarr storage, enabling DSSAT-ready analytics workflows while reducing environment setup time by 90%.

Designed fault-tolerant, idempotent ingestion pipelines using Docker, ECS/Fargate, async processing, and scheduled batch workflows, reducing large-scale processing time by 70% and improving workflow reliability for scientific data processing.

Built concurrent processing services handling 1000+ coordinate-based requests using async I/O, batching, lazy loading, and Redis-backed caching, significantly improving throughput and retrieval performance for compute-intensive workloads.

Optimized scientific data storage and retrieval using compressed Zarr formats, intelligent caching, and cloud object storage strategies, reducing storage footprint by 60% while improving scalability for multi-terabyte datasets.

Engineered production-grade RAG and Agent-as-a-Judge evaluation systems using Qdrant, PostgreSQL, and distributed asynchronous pipelines, improving retrieval relevance and contextual answer accuracy by ~40% while reducing evaluation latency by ~65%.

timeline.title: Backend Developer
timeline.description: Designed and delivered high-scale event-driven backend systems on Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, and AWS, processing 15M+ daily events with 4x higher throughput, sub-350ms latency, and 120K+ requests per minute. Led EKS migration, automated CI/CD, and improved observability, reliability, and deployment frequency across distributed microservices.
achievements: Architected and developed large-scale event-driven transaction processing systems using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka (MSK), PostgreSQL (RDS), Redis (ElastiCache), and Amazon EKS, supporting 15M+ daily events across distributed microservices with high availability and reliability.

Improved platform throughput by 4x and reduced end-to-end processing latency from ~2s to under 350ms through asynchronous processing, optimized batching, distributed caching, and JVM/database performance tuning.

Built high-throughput REST and asynchronous APIs handling 120K+ requests/minute with p99 latency below 180ms, leveraging scalable microservice architectures, Redis caching, API Gateway, and load-balanced deployments.

Led migration from VM-based deployments to containerized microservices on Amazon EKS, reducing deployment failures by 80% while improving scalability, deployment consistency, and infrastructure utilization.

Developed automated CI/CD pipelines using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, Docker, Helm, and GitHub Actions, enabling zero-downtime deployments and increasing deployment frequency from weekly releases to 20+ production deployments per day.

Implemented centralized observability, autoscaling, health checks, distributed tracing, and PostgreSQL query optimizations using CloudWatch, Prometheus, and Grafana, reducing incident detection time by 60% and significantly improving operational visibility and system performance.
Collaborated with product, infrastructure, and SRE teams to design resilient distributed systems, scalable API contracts, and deployment strategies supporting millions of daily user interactions.
Mentored junior engineers on Kafka, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production debugging to improve onboarding efficiency and engineering velocity.

Integrated role-based authorization and security protocols to ensure secure login and compliance, applying internal best practices to minimize incidents by 30% and enhance system reliability

Optimized order tracking workflows by automating manual processes, decoupling dependency on support tickets by 40%, and saving 200 hours annually, thereby delivering customer-focused software solutions
